quote: try { localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_KEY, raw); } catch (e) { /* storage is already failing; the load message says so */ }
title: Backup failure is swallowed while the user is told the unreadable data 'was kept'
evidence: backupRaw (store.js:29-31) discards the setItem error and returns nothing. The callers at store.js:48, 53 and 67 then return a message that says the data 'was kept under notes-backup'. The comment claims the load message reports the failure, but those messages never mention one. The backup copies the whole raw string, so it needs as much free space as the corrupted blob already occupies; a large blob or a nearly full store makes the write throw.
failing_case: Storage holds a corrupted 'notes' value of about half the browser quota or more (or the origin is near full). Reload: JSON.parse fails, backupRaw's setItem throws QuotaExceededError and is ignored, and the status reads 'The unreadable data was kept under "notes-backup"'. The user creates a note; saveNotes overwrites the 'notes' key (the old value is freed, so the write succeeds). The only copy of the old data is gone, and the user was told it was safe.
remediation: Make backupRaw return whether it succeeded, and have loadNotes word the message from that result ('could NOT be backed up'). When the backup fails, do not let saveNotes overwrite the key until the user confirms.

title: Every save rewrites the whole notes list from one tab's memory, so a second tab erases the first tab's notes
evidence: app.js:18 reads the list once at load into `notes`. store.js:75 writes the complete list back on each save. No `storage` event listener exists in app.js, and nothing re-reads storage before a write. Traced; the browser could not be driven because Bash was denied.
failing_case: Open the app in tab A and tab B (both load the same list). In tab A press New note and type a body. In tab B, which has not been reloaded, edit any note and wait 500 ms. Tab B writes its stale list and the note created in tab A is gone from storage. No error is shown: status says 'Saved'. Refresh tab A and the note is missing.
remediation: Before each write, re-read storage and merge by id (or write per-note keys), and listen for the `storage` event to refresh `notes`. At minimum, detect that storage changed since load and warn instead of overwriting.

title: Every list render destroys the focused button, so keyboard and screen-reader focus is lost on opening or deleting a note
evidence: renderList rebuilds every <li> and button on each call. selectNote (app.js:100) and deleteNote (app.js:121) call it after a button was activated. Nothing restores focus or moves it to the editor (only createNote focuses, at app.js:109). The editor section comes after the whole nav in DOM order (index.html:12-26). WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order (Level A).
failing_case: Keyboard only: Tab to the 40th note's 'open' button and press Enter. The button is removed from the DOM, focus falls to <body>, and the next Tab starts at the top of the page. To reach the title field the user tabs through the search box, New note and up to 80 list buttons. After pressing Delete, focus is likewise lost. A screen-reader user is dropped back to the top of the document.
remediation: Update list items in place, or re-focus the button with the same data-id after replaceChildren. After selecting a note, move focus to #title. After deleting, move focus to the neighbouring item or to #new.

title: 'Search notes' matches titles only, so text inside a note is never found
evidence: index.html:14 labels the field 'Search notes'. The filter reads only n.title. Empty-state copy at app.js:87 then says 'No notes match ...' for terms that appear in note bodies.
failing_case: Note titled 'Shopping' has body 'buy oat milk'. Type 'milk' in the search box. The list is empty and reads 'No notes match "milk".' although the note contains it.

requirement.why: the field is labelled 'Search notes' and the search runs against the notes, not just their titles

remediation: Filter on title and body, or relabel the field 'Search titles' and make the empty-state copy say 'No titles match'.

title: New note is created and opened while an active search hides it from the list
evidence: createNote (app.js:103-111) does not clear the search box. renderList filters by the query, and 'Untitled' fails any query that does not match it. Traced.
failing_case: Type 'meeting' in the search box and press New note. The editor opens an empty note, but the list shows 'No notes match "meeting"'. The new note cannot be seen or reopened until the search is cleared.
remediation: Clear the search value (and call searchShared('')) in createNote before selecting the new note.

title: At phone width the editor sits below the whole list, and tapping a note shows no visible change
evidence: Below 720 px the grid is one column (styles.css:19), so the list comes first and the editor is below it. The 'open' click handler (app.js:165) loads the note but never scrolls or focuses; only createNote calls focus().
failing_case: At 390 px width with about 15 notes, each row being about 36 px tall, the editor starts well below the first screen. Tap a note: its row gets a highlight, but the title and body that changed are off-screen. The user has to scroll to find them and may conclude the tap did nothing.
remediation: On narrow screens, either focus the title (scrollIntoView) after selecting a note, or show list and editor as two views with a Back control. Cap the list height with its own scroll area.
